note: No `identifier`: a claim is for one identifier, because the mediator holds one connection per identifier and exclusion is agreed per identifier (VTI-NTF-081).
A duration under a minute would have the client's connection closing as it opened, and a renewal cycle shorter than the round trip that renews it.
A duration beyond thirty days is never granted: a claim is a lease so that an identifier whose claimant disappeared returns to the VTA (VTI-NTF-084).
Unknown member — a client naming another client to hand the identifier to — is refused: a claim is always the caller's own.
